spec.title: Add 'Extension Points' sections to system docs
spec.context:
System docs describe architecture well but don't guide how to extend the system. LLMs (and humans) must reverse-engineer extension patterns from existing code.
Evidence: Task 015 had to discover global-actions-view.capability.ts as a template via exploration. This knowledge could be baked into the doc instead.
The value is faster, more consistent implementations - the doc becomes a 'how to add new X' guide, not just 'what X is'.

in-scope.item: Add Extension Points section template to engineering-system.md template
Add guidance for writing Extension Points to festina-finalize docs-engineering.md
Extension Points section includes: template file, checklist, pitfalls per component type

requirements.requirement: The engineering-system.md template SHALL include an "Extension Points" section placeholder
Each extension point subsection SHALL include: template file to copy, checklist of files to modify, common pitfalls
The docs-engineering.md skill guidance SHALL explain how to identify and document extension points
The docs-engineering.md skill guidance SHALL provide examples of well-written extension point documentation
Extension points SHALL be organized by component type (e.g., "Adding a new Capability", "Adding a new Orchestrator")
